titulo: What Happens to the Colony After You Squish the Ants on Your Counter?
titulos_alternativos: Why the Ants on Your Counter Always Come Back
Squishing Ants Doesn't Work. Here's Why
descripcion:
Seven in the morning. A perfect line of tiny ants is marching from a crack by the window to the sugar bowl. You squish them all. By lunch, the line is back. So what actually happens to the colony when you squish the ants on your counter?

The invisible scent map, why the ants you see are only a tiny part of the colony, the rotten coconut test, why bug spray can split one colony into three, what ants do with their dead (and what E. O. Wilson discovered), and what actually works.
